name: Carriage Hill MetroPark
shortDescription: Woods, thickets, meadows and prairie, all in one park — and at the centre of it an 1880s farm brought back to life, complete with period farm animals in the barns. There's also a pond, a wooden bridge and a shallow creek.
bestFor: Families who want a rustic barn and farmhouse feel, children who do better with something to look at, and longer sessions that need variety without a lot of driving.
restrooms: Yes — accessible restrooms at the visitor center, the historical farm, and Cedar Lake.
parking: Free, with multiple lots throughout the park (visitor center, Cedar Lake, and other areas).
seasonalNote: The most varied location I use, which is why so many Extended sessions start here.
